title: PreToolUse 'defer' Permission Decision (v2.1.89)
description: Headless sessions can now pause at a specific tool call by returning 'defer' from a PreToolUse hook, then resume later with 'claude -p --resume' to have the hook re-evaluate. Enables human-in-the-loop checkpoints in otherwise fully-autonomous pipelines without abandoning session context. Distinct from: PermissionDenied hook (fires after denial), PreToolUse allow/deny (synchronous block). New pattern: automation runs unattended until a 'dangerous' tool call, pauses, human reviews and resumes.
